{{Top|leg}}
'''Tobal lenses''' were vital components of [[needle ship]]s. They were powerful enough to blind those who looked into them, because they converted heat into light with near-perfect efficiency. A good Tobal lens could convert heat to light at close to a one hundred percent efficiency rate. They resembled like oval crystals about the size of a human head and were full of sparkling colors. The lens were used to power the old [[Renatta Racing Systems]] photon drives.
